episodes.title: Assassination Time
episodes.summary: A creature who blasted the moon into a crescent shows up at Kunugigaoka Junior High School and gives the students a year to assassinate him.

episodes.title: Baseball Time
episodes.summary: The reasoning behind the E Class's segregation is revealed. Nagisa tracks Koro Senei's weak points in the hopes of using them to take him down.

episodes.title: Karma Time
episodes.summary: The brilliant, belligerent Karma Akabane, Nagisa's former classmate, joins 3-E and immediately jumps into the assassination mission with both feet.

episodes.title: Grown-Up Time
episodes.summary: A new foreign-language teacher comes to 3-E with some major ulterior motives.

episodes.title: Assembly Time
episodes.summary: Before the torturous school assembly begins, Okuda attempts to poison Kpro Sensei in an unexpected way. With unexpected results.

episodes.title: Test Time
episodes.summary: Koro Sensei gives his aspiring assassins an ultimatum as they battle a grueling test and disdain from the rest of the school.

episodes.title: School Trip Time - First Period
episodes.summary: The students go on a school trip to Kyoto where they must still keep assassination on their mind.

episodes.title: School Trip Time - Second Period
episodes.summary: Kayano and Kanzaki are kidnapped by students from a rival school. The school is busy preparing for their long-awaited trip to Kyoto when it occurs.

episodes.title: Transfer Student Time
episodes.summary: A new student joins the E Class with a single minded focus on assassination that drives her fellow classmates to distraction.

episodes.title: LR Time
episodes.summary: Professor Jelavich is forced to prove her assassin skills when her mentor pays a visit to the school. Koro Senei takes Nagisa and Karma on a trip they will never forget.

episodes.title: Transfer Student Time - Second Period
episodes.summary: A new assassin student with a goal to kill korosensei joins Class E.

episodes.title: Ball Game Tournament Time
episodes.summary: The E Class boys must play the Baseball Club in an exhibition game meant to humiliate them.

episodes.title: Talent Time
episodes.summary: Mr. Takaoka upsets others with his unconventional training methods when he comes to help Mr. Karasuma; Nagisa shows a hidden talent.

episodes.title: Vision Time
episodes.summary: Koro Sensei exposes a major weakness while Terasaka interrupts a fun summer day with an assassination attempt that goes just a bit too far.

episodes.title: End-of-Term Time
episodes.summary: Final time arrives and Koro Sensei gives his class a new goal. He offers the class a tempting reward and the E Class makes a deal with the A Class's top tier Big Five.

episodes.title: School's Out - First Term
episodes.summary: The results are in after two days of exams. Both the ace A Class and the end E Class has to come to terms with the outcome as well as Koro Sensei.

episodes.title: Island Time
episodes.summary: The E Class trains intensely with a professional killer in order to prepare for their island assassination. Once they arrive at the island they must make sure everything falls in place.

episodes.title: Go Time
episodes.summary: The summer training assassination attempt is followed by a unexpected crisis that affects almost half of the E Class students.

episodes.title: Pandemonium Time
episodes.summary: The E Class students have to put the lessons they have learned into practical use when the unexpected crisis forces them to deal with a hotel full of bad guys without Koro Sensei's help.

episodes.title: Karma Time - Second Period
episodes.summary: The group of students from E Class head upwards in the hotel facing more assassins as they go.

episodes.title: XX Time
episodes.summary: The students meet the shadowy figure orchestrating their fellow students sickness after facing one last assassin. The mastermind wants Koro Sensei in exchange for the virus remedy.

episodes.title: Nagisa Time
episodes.summary: The students of E Class arrive to a showdown on the roof as Nagisa battles for his fellow classmates lives.

episodes.title: Before & After Time
episodes.summary: E Class starts studying differently off the campus after an accident; The students start to worry about their midterm exams.

episodes.title: Reaper Time, Part 1
episodes.summary: E Class must face off against a powerful foe alone after a fall out with a professor.

episodes.title: Reaper Time, Part 2
episodes.summary: Koro Sensei and Mr. Karasuma find the Reaper's hideout and no one knows who will come out on top.

episodes.title: Round Two Time
episodes.summary: Nagisa tries to accept his talent; students  consider possible future career paths.

episodes.title: School Festival Time
episodes.summary: E class competes with the rest of the school for the highest sales totals at the school's festival.

episodes.title: End-of-Term Time/2nd Period
episodes.summary: At exam time, a class is once again a huge threat; Asano has a trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Think Outside the Box Time
episodes.summary: Asano makes a big wager with Koro Sensei; The exams end with a very difficult final problem.

episodes.title: Let Live Time
episodes.summary: E Class puts on a play with twists at the drama festival; Asano remembers his first education job.

episodes.title: Secret Identity Time
episodes.summary: E Class cleans up after the festival; a classmate has a secret connecting to Koro Senei's past.

episodes.title: Past Time
episodes.summary: E Class is stunned after learning about Koro Sensei's past; they become unsure of their plans.

episodes.title: Discord Time
episodes.summary: With the class split over whether to kill Koro Sensei or save him, Koro Sensei makes a suggestion.

episodes.title: Outcome Time
episodes.summary: Koro Senseu's fate comes to a battle between old friends; a new obstacle throws a wrench into the plans.

episodes.title: Outer Space Time
episodes.summary: Class 3-E goes to lengths to track down information that might help them keep Koro Sensei alive.

episodes.title: Valentine Time
episodes.summary: With high-school entrance exams looming, Nagisa is unsure which path his future should take.

episodes.title: Trust Time
episodes.summary: Koro has one more project planned for his E Class, but the government's plans get in the way.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday Time
episodes.summary: The students fight to see their teacher one last time; a figure from Koro Sensei's past arrives.

episodes.title: Final Boss Time
episodes.summary: A pitched battle between two super creatures threatens to harm the students of Class 3-E.

episodes.title: Graduation Time
episodes.summary: E Class students must decide whether to kill the teacher who changed their lives over the past year.

episodes.title: Future Time
episodes.summary: Graduation Day: The students and teachers of Class 3-E go on to forge their own paths in the world.
